svg.text: Order of work, agreed with the supervisor on 17 November
ever killed in the run? Only
Full run first: all data, suites scored on the same mutants.
Reduced runs: less data or fewer mutants, at random and
by mutation operator. Their suites are scored on held-out
mutants (proposed, to confirm with the supervisor).
Learn the tree: one per oracle, from the chosen training data
One training example = one (starting scenario, mutant) pair
input ego lane, TTC and TG to 6 neighbours
label was this mutant killed? yes / no
The input is the same for every mutant of a scenario.
1 · The training data is split 5 times by mutant into a fitting and a validation part.
2 · 200 trials per leaf bound (16, 68, 160, 512), each scored by ROC-AUC on validation mutants.
3 · The best setting is refitted on all training data; only that tree is used.
Implementation: a scenario's pairs collapse into two weighted rows (killed / not killed), same splits, about 86× fewer rows.
by its state at tick 0: project
Draw test suites and score them, for each oracle
by tree leaves, per leaf bound
or weighted by training kill rate.
scenarios drawn until the first kill
1 · Suite size: how many scoring mutants are killed after n draws (n from 1 to 2000, as in NEXT_TICK_SUITE_SIZES).
2 · Time to kill: how many draws until a scoring mutant is first killed. Draw every scenario; 100 repetitions; median and spread.
Scoring mutants: held out in reduced runs, the training mutants in the full run. Both measures are lookups in the kill matrices.
Later · highway traffic, once these results exist (needs new simulation runs)
Store the raw scene per tick,
Apply both TSCs and the trees.
